newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-RONALDO TO STAR IN SOAP OPERA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO TO STAR IN SOAP OPERA.

text.p: Brazilian soccer idol Ronaldo is to star in a Brazilian soap opera in a role in which he falls in love with his real-life actress girlfriend Suzana Werner, a Globo Television spokesman said on Tuesday.
"Ronaldo will play the part of a female soccer team coach and Suzana is one of the players on the team," the spokesman said. "Of course, the two fall in love."

Ronaldo, the world footballer of the year, will be appearing in mid-July in three episodes of the "Malhacao" (Workout) early evening soap opera which revolves around a sports centre, the spokesman said.
Globo Television would not reveal how much it was paying the soccer star for his acting escapade.
Ronaldo, 20, is currently involved in a dispute between his Spanish club Barcelona and Italy's Internazionale over which team he will play for next season.
